caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug positioned upright and facing slightly to the right. The jug is grayish in color with a slightly textured surface, featuring a rounded body that tapers inward at the neck, and flares out slightly at the rim. It has a sturdy handle attached from the upper neck to the shoulder of the jug, positioned on the left side. The jug has a small spout that juts out from the rim opposite the handle. Blue decorative patterns and inscriptions are present on the upper and lower areas of the jug’s body; the text “Jas. H…” and “Green…” is partially visible, presented in a painted style. The background is plain and off-white, bordered by a thin line forming a rectangular frame around the entire composition. The bottom right corner contains a small inscription in faint writing, indicating the artist's name and the year "1897."
title: Batter Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
